V1 Wire story · sec-pro-penalties
smell: This matters because professional experience has become part of the roster conversation while the NCAA’s eligibility rules remain tied up in litigation.
A former NFL, NBA or WNBA player is not simply another transfer.
That athlete could bring a different level of experience to a college roster, which helps explain why conferences are trying to discourage schools from pursuing the option.
LSU’s abstention gives the decision a direct Baton Rouge connection.
The Tigers have players tied to the court-based eligibility fight, and the conference has now approved penalties while that legal dispute continues.
